instruction: I want my screen to automatically turn off after 5 minutes of being idle. Can you enable this feature?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

The evaluator checks if idle-delay is set to 300 seconds (5 minutes). Uses existing exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
